title: oblien/openship
claim: oblien/openship — A self-hosted deployment platform for shipping apps and AI agents to infrastructure you control.
hook: Self-hosted Vercel for the agent era — push to deploy on your own boxes, no per-seat PaaS bill.
why_good: Coolify proved teams will self-host their PaaS to escape per-seat, per-usage cloud bills; openship chases the next slice — deploying AI agents and services, not just web apps — on infrastructure you own; ~9k stars says the demand keeps growing.
value: A managed cloud plus priced support and team tiers on top of the open core (the Coolify/GitLab playbook), sold to startups and agencies that want Vercel ergonomics without Vercel economics.
risk: Crowded — Coolify, Dokploy, Kamal, Render — and deploy-platform is a feature big clouds keep absorbing; the agent-deployment angle has to become a real wedge, not a tagline.

zh.claim: oblien/openship —— 自托管的部署平台,把应用和 AI agent 发布到你自己掌控的基础设施上。
zh.hook: agent 时代的自托管版 Vercel——推一下就部署到自己的机器,不再按席位交 PaaS 费。
zh.why_good: Coolify 已证明:团队愿意自托管 PaaS 来摆脱按席位、按用量的云账单;openship 盯的是下一块——不只部署网页应用,还部署 AI agent 和服务,全在你自有的基础设施上;约 9 千星说明需求还在涨。
zh.value: 在开源内核之上做托管云 + 付费支持和团队版(Coolify/GitLab 的打法),卖给想要 Vercel 般体验、又不想要 Vercel 账单的初创和代理商。
zh.risk: 赛道拥挤——Coolify、Dokploy、Kamal、Render——「部署平台」还是大厂不断吸收的功能;agent 部署这个角度必须做成真正的切入点,而非口号。

pick_reason: A clear open-core PaaS (managed + team tiers) riding proven self-host-your-deploy demand.
